name: What are the benefits of repairing a damaged window screen?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of repairing a damaged window screen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a damaged window screen offers several key benefits. It restores your ability to open windows for ventilation without allowing insects, pests, or debris into your home. A functional screen also enhances home security by acting as a basic barrier. Furthermore, repairing a screen is generally more cost-effective and environmentally friendly than replacing the entire unit, while maintaining your home's aesthetic appeal and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing a screen restores ventilation, keeps out pests, enhances basic security, and is cost-effective.
